Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: Always the first field in a FIX message. Valid value: FIX.4.2

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Always the second field in a FIX message. Length of message expressed as the number of characters following the BodyLength field up to and including the delimiter immediately preceding the CheckSum tag.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Always the third field in a FIX message. Defines the message type.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Message sequence number (numeric).

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Set to Y in messages from MIAX during certain failure/recovery scenarios. Ignored in messages sent to MIAX.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: Identifies the party sending the message. The sending firm should use their Line Identifier as assigned by MIAX. MIAX will use "MIAX" when sending messages to firms.

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: Sub identifier of the party sending the message. Required for application messages sent from firm to MIAX.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Time of message transmission in UTC. Must be within 60 seconds of the current time else the order will be rejected. Format: YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.uuu

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: Identifies the party receiving the message. Firms should use the value "MIAX". MIAX will use the firm's Line ID when sending messages to firms.

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Sub identifier of the party receiving the message. Required for application messages delivered to firms from MIAX.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Ignored in messages sent to MIAX. Set to Y in messages from MIAX during certain failure/recovery scenarios.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfCompID
Field.Description: Only applicable to messages sent to MIAX: identifies the end client that is the originator of the message. Returned in the DeliverToCompID of corresponding messages.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfSubID
Field.Description: Only applicable to messages sent to MIAX: sub identifier of the end client. Returned in the DeliverToSubID of corresponding messages.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Required for resent messages. If no data is available, set to the SendingTime value. Format: YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.uuu

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: Only applicable to messages sent from MIAX: MIAX reflects back the data sent in OnBehalfOfCompID.

Field.Name: DeliverToSubID
Field.Description: Only applicable to messages sent from MIAX: MIAX reflects back the data sent in OnBehalfOfSubID.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Always the last field of a FIX message.

Field.Name: RawDataLength
Field.Description: The number of bytes in RawData. When used, must be set to 1. Omit tags 95 and 96 when Auto Cancel on Disconnect (ACOD) is not required.

Field.Name: RawData
Field.Description: Raw data of the length specified in RawDataLength. Valid values: "1" = Activate Auto Cancel on Disconnect (ACOD) on disconnect or graceful logout.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: Encryption is not supported and hence this field is ignored.

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Value specified in seconds. Must be greater than 0 and the same value must be used by both sides. A Heartbeat interval of 5 seconds is recommended.

Field.Name: ResetSeqNumFlag
Field.Description: Indicates both sides of a FIX session should reset sequence numbers.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Required when the heartbeat is the result of a Test Request message.

Field.Name: TestReqID
Field.Description: Test request identifier to be returned in the resulting Heartbeat.

Field.Name: BeginSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of first message in range to be resent.

Field.Name: EndSeqNo
Field.Description: Message sequence number of last message in range to be resent.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum of rejected message.

Field.Name: RefTagID
Field.Description: Required if reject reason refers to a specific tag.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: The MsgType of the FIX message being referenced.

Field.Name: SessionRejectReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for a session-level Reject message.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Supplied if there is a need to provide more information regarding the reject.

Field.Name: GapFillFlag
Field.Description: Indicates that this message is replacing administrative or application messages which will not be resent.

Field.Name: NewSeqNo
Field.Description: New sequence number.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Can be used to send readable information to the recipient. FOI will just log this.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Customer ID defined by the firms. Maximum length 10 characters. FOI will pass this through for clearing.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the order as assigned by the firm for the MPID used to populate SenderSubID. Must be 30 characters or less. Uniqueness must be guaranteed within a single trading day for an MPID regardless of FIX Session.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Valid values: f = Inter-market Sweep Order (ISO); o = Auto Cancel on connection loss (ACOD for this order). Any other value rejects the order.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of contracts specified on the order. Valid range: 1 to 999,999. Max length 6.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Valid values: 1 = Market, 2 = Limit.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price for limit orders (OrdType = 2). Standard OCC clearing format, combined total digits before and after the decimal is 8 or less (4 before, 4 after). Should not be specified on market orders.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order. Valid values: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: The 6 character OCC Security Symbol (Class) for an option.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Specifies how long the order remains in effect.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time the order was initiated/released expressed in UTC. Format: YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.uuu

Field.Name: ExecBroker
Field.Description: MIAX assigned directed firm code of the designated participant for directed order flow. Max of 4 characters.

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: Specifies if this order opens or closes a position. Required except when CustomerOrFirm is 4 or 5. Valid values: O = Open, C = Close.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: Identifies type of instrument. Valid value: OPT.

Field.Name: MaturityMonthYear
Field.Description: Expiration month and year. Format: YYYYMM.

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: Indicates whether an option is a put or a call. Valid values: 0 = Put, 1 = Call.

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: Strike price for an option.

Field.Name: CoveredOrUncovered
Field.Description: Specifies whether the option position is covered or uncovered. Valid values: 0 = Covered, 1 = Uncovered.

Field.Name: CustomerOrFirm
Field.Description: Specifies the order origin type.

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: Expiration day of month, used with MaturityMonthYear (200) to fully specify the maturity date for options. Format: DD.

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: OCC sub-account (Multi-account). Required for Non-member MM orders. MIAX Member MM can send their MPID in this tag in lieu of tag 109. UPPERCASE alphanumeric, maximum 5 characters.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: For MIAX member Market Maker orders, MMs can send their MPID with this tag in lieu of tag 109.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: MIAX assigned directed firm code of the designated participant for directed order flow. Max of 4 characters.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Additional information about the order.

Field.Name: MaxPriceLevels
Field.Description: MIAX Variable Protection (MVP). Unspecified = use default configured in Pearl system. 0 = order eligible to trade only at its Initial Reference Price (IRP); 1 through 20 = maximum ticks (MPVs) beyond IRP before cancel back (capped to Pearl maximum); greater than 20 = order rejected.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the cancel request, assigned by the institution. Must be 30 characters or less.

Field.Name: RequestType
Field.Description: When absent, request is treated as a request for canceling a single order. Required for mass cancels. Valid values: 0 = Single order cancel; 31 = Mass cancel of all orders for this MPID on this Session only; 32 = Mass cancel of GTC orders for this MPID.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: RequestType greater than 0: ignored. RequestType 0 or missing: required.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the targeted order to cancel. Must be 30 characters or less. RequestType greater than 0: ignored.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order, must match the original order. Valid values: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell. Not required for multileg orders.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: Identifies type of instrument.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: The 6 character OCC Security Symbol (Class) for an option.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time the cancel request was initiated. Format: YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.uuu

Field.Name: MaturityMonthYear
Field.Description: Expiration month and year. Format: YYYYMM.

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: Expiration day of month. Format: DD.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the replacement order. Cannot be changed.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Order quantity of the replacement order.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Order type of the replacement order. May be changed. Valid values: 1 = Market, 2 = Limit.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the targeted order when canceling or replacing an order.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price for limit orders (OrdType = 2). Should not be specified on market orders.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order. Must match the original order. Valid values: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: The 6 character OCC Security Symbol (Class) for an option. Value must match original order.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Additional information about the order. Must be re-specified if it was on the original order and needs to be carried over.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Specifies how long the order remains in effect. Valid replaces: OPG, DAY or GTC may be replaced to OPG, DAY or GTC.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time request was initiated/released expressed in UTC. Format: YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.uuu

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: Specifies if this order opens or closes a position. Required except when CustomerOrFirm is 4 or 5. Valid values: O = Open, C = Close.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: For MIAX member Market Maker orders, MM can send their MPID. Must match original order.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: Identifies type of instrument. Valid value: OPT.

Field.Name: MaturityMonthYear
Field.Description: Expiration month and year. Value must match the original order. Format: YYYYMM.

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: Must match the original order. Valid values: 0 = Put, 1 = Call.

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: Strike price for an option, which must match the original order.

Field.Name: CoveredOrUncovered
Field.Description: Specifies covered or uncovered options. Required if tag present in original order. Valid values: 0 = Covered, 1 = Uncovered.

Field.Name: CustomerOrFirm
Field.Description: Specifies the order origin type.

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: Expiration day of month. Format: DD.

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: Clearing Member Transfer Agreement. Required if value was on the original order and needs to be carried over.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: OCC sub-account (Multi-account). Required for Non-member MM orders. Must match original order. UPPERCASE alphanumeric, maximum 5 characters.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique order ID assigned by institution to the cancel request or to the replacement order.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Status of order after the Cancel Reject function is applied.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the order that cannot be canceled or replaced. Does not apply to the initial order of the day.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Text describing error specified in Appendix C: Error Code Table. Format: 'Error Code': 'Description'.

Field.Name: CxlRejReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for cancel rejection. Valid values: 0 = Too late to cancel; 1 = Unknown order; 2 = Broker Option; 3 = Previous cancel or cancel/replace request is still pending.

Field.Name: CxlRejResponseTo
Field.Description: Identifies the type of request that a Cancel Reject is in response to. Valid values: 1 = Order Cancel Request; 2 = Order Cancel/Replace Request.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Customer ID defined by the firms.

Field.Name: AvgPx
Field.Description: Average price of the fills on this order.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the order.

Field.Name: CumQty
Field.Description: Total number of contracts filled.

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the execution report.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Execution instructions.

Field.Name: ExecTransType
Field.Description: Valid values: 0 = New, 3 = Status.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of the last fill. Not required for ExecTransType = 3 (Status).

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity of contracts in the last fill.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the order as assigned by MIAX.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Order quantity.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Order status.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Order type.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Original ClOrdID.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Order price.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order. Valid values: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell, 5 = Sell Short (stock leg), 6 = Sell Short Exempt (stock leg).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: For Option Legs: the 6 character OCC Security Symbol (Class) for an option.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Additional information / error text.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Time in force.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of transaction expressed in UTC.

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: Specifies if this order opens or closes a position.

Field.Name: OrdRejReason
Field.Description: The reason the order was rejected.

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Identifies the type of execution report.

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: Number of open contracts for further execution. If the OrdStatus is Canceled or Rejected then LeavesQty = 0, otherwise LeavesQty = OrderQty - CumQty.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: The type of security. Valid values: OPT or MLEG.

Field.Name: MaturityMonthYear
Field.Description: Option leg only. Expiration month and year. Format: YYYYMM.

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: Option leg only. Valid values: 0 = Put, 1 = Call.

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: Option leg only. Strike price for an option.

Field.Name: CustomerOrFirm
Field.Description: Specifies the order origin type as specified on the order.

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: Option leg only. Expiration day of month. Format: DD.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Exchange ID (MIC code) of the Option Exchange on which this execution occurred when it occurs on an exchange other than MIAX.

Field.Name: TradeID
Field.Description: MIAX assigned unique Trade ID (FIX 4.4 TradeID, confirmed via FXD).

Field.Name: AdditionalBillingParameters
Field.Description: Additional billing parameters (see Appendix D; tag 9730 confirmed via FXD).

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: The ClOrdID of the order being requested. Must be 30 characters or less.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Order side, which must match the original order for simple orders. Valid values: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell. Not required for Complex Orders.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: The 6 character OCC Security Symbol (Class) for an option.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: Valid value: OPT or MLEG.

Field.Name: UserStatus
Field.Description: User status.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of event creation expressed in UTC.

Field.Name: MPIDGroupID
Field.Description: Firm assigned Group ID. Alphanumeric, max length 32.

Field.Name: MetricID
Field.Description: Metric ID for the group. Alphanumeric, max length 32.

Field.Name: RoutingID
Field.Description: Firm assigned Routing ID. Alphanumeric, max length 32.

Field.Name: MetricType
Field.Description: Valid values: C = Rate of Executed Order Contracts; O = Rate of New/Replace Orders Received.

Field.Name: EventType
Field.Description: Determines the reason for the notification. Valid values: S = Period Status/Pulse Notification; T = Safeguard Trigger; R = Reset Risk Metric; W = Warning Only; D = Metric Deleted; A = Metric Added; P = Metric Paused; U = Metric Un-Paused.

Field.Name: MessageID
Field.Description: Unique ID assigned by MIAX for this event. Unsolicited messages have a value of zero.

Field.Name: ConfiguredCountingTimePeriod
Field.Description: Configured time period in milliseconds used to consider events for this Metric ID.

Field.Name: ConfiguredMaxQuantity
Field.Description: Configured max threshold of counted items for the configured counting time interval for this Metric ID.

Field.Name: CurrentQuantity
Field.Description: Current counted quantity at the time of the event for this Metric ID.

Field.Name: MaxPeakQuantity
Field.Description: Max peak for Current Quantity during pulse interval.

Field.Name: PercentageLevel
Field.Description: Current percentage for the counted quantity in relationship to Configured Max Quantity. Valid values 0 to 255%.

Field.Name: ProtectionType
Field.Description: Valid values: B = Block all MPIDs for this MPID Group ID; M = Block all MPIDs and mass-cancel all day orders; W = Warning only.

Field.Name: RefSeqNum
Field.Description: MsgSeqNum of rejected message.

Field.Name: RefMsgType
Field.Description: MsgType of the FIX message being rejected.

Field.Name: BusinessRejectRefID
Field.Description: Ref ID of the message being rejected. ExecID if an Execution Report is being rejected, ClOrdID if an Order/Cancel message, CrossID if a New Order Cross.

Field.Name: BusinessRejectReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for Business rejection.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Required if BusinessRejectReason = 0.
